en: Distinctions Concerning Mind Combined with Discourse (Suttanta)
In whom a mind with lust arises …pe… in whom a mind free from lust arises; in whom a mind with hatred arises … in whom a mind free from hatred arises;
in whom a mind with delusion arises … in whom a mind free from delusion arises; in whom a contracted mind arises … in whom a distracted mind arises.
A consciousness arises... for one whose exalted consciousness arises... for one whose non-exalted consciousness arises...
for one whose surpassable consciousness arises... for one whose unsurpassable consciousness arises... for one whose concentrated consciousness arises...
for one whose unconcentrated consciousness arises... for one whose liberated consciousness arises.
… for whom an unliberated consciousness arises …?
